author: Cleo Abram
description:
This SpaceX rocket is about to hit the moon at seven times the speed of sound.

It launched over a year ago and was left drifting in space until gravity pulled it in towards the Moon.

We’re keeping a close eye on what happens to learn how future impacts could affect astronauts that we send to the moon!

To see what we learn, subscribe

title: This Rocket Is About To Hit The Moon
